name: Matcha
siboNotes: Well-tolerated for SIBO as it's naturally FODMAP-free. The caffeine may stimulate gastric motility which can be beneficial for some SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Use 1-2 teaspoons of matcha powder per cup of hot water (not boiling)
Whisk vigorously to prevent clumping and create froth
Add lactose-free milk or plant-based milk for matcha lattes
Sweeten with maple syrup or sugar if desired, avoiding honey
nutritionalHighlights: High in antioxidants, particularly catechins and EGCG
Good source of chlorophyll and vitamin C
